grid_status: New explicit rectangular-grid hypothesis for this experiment only
selection_status: Assistant-selected draft boundaries, not user-reviewed measurements
angle_definition: Degrees from vertical, positive overhang. Middle and upper are spatial panels, not a time-varying rotation of the whole wall.
lower_panel_rule: Vertical plane through the observed lower hinge; its normal is inferred conditionally from that edge.
floor_rule: Horizontal plane at mean reconstructed floor-edge height; endpoint disagreement is reported.
ground_evidence_rule: Only source-visible feet near the modeled floor edge, below its boundary, and stable for at least 10 frames. Raw contact labels are retained separately; no lack-of-hold inference.
